neighbours.label: the head of a domain-programme compound in institutional prose: the noun or preposition after a subject field (climate policy, arts news, privacy legislation, nutrition at), versus the same institutions described without a field
fire: He is a researcher in epidemiology at Stanford University.

Every evening the station airs local sports news.
